features.name: Core Review Module
features.description: Create the review_round.py module with ReviewConfig, ReviewResult, and ReviewRound classes to orchestrate independent review of implementation rounds

goals.primary: Create a self-contained review module that can validate implementation work against tracker requirements
secondary: Enable configurable review executors and models
Provide structured review result parsing with robust JSON extraction
measurable_outcomes: Review agent runs independently after each implementation round
Git diff is compared against task requirements
Structured JSON output is parsed and applied to tracker

tasks.description: Create tools/auto_prd/review_round.py module file with dataclass definitions for ReviewConfig and ReviewResult
Implement ReviewRound.__init__ with repo_root and config initialization
Implement execute_review method that gets git diff, builds prompt, calls reviewer agent, and returns ReviewResult
Implement build_review_prompt method with task requirements, tracker state, and git diff context
Implement parse_review_result method with robust JSON extraction using regex fallback patterns
Implement apply_review_updates method to update tracker with status changes and review insights

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ReviewRound class initializes correctly with repo_root and optional ReviewConfig
execute_review returns ReviewResult with iteration, reviewer, timestamp, and status fields populated
build_review_prompt includes iteration number, base branch, git SHA, tasks to review, tracker summary, and git diff
parse_review_result extracts valid JSON even when wrapped in markdown code blocks or preceded by explanatory text
apply_review_updates modifies tracker in-place with status changes and adds review insights to tasks and features

unit_tests.description: Test ReviewConfig dataclass initialization with default and custom values
Test ReviewResult dataclass initialization and field validation
Test ReviewRound.execute_review with mocked git diff and agent response
Test build_review_prompt generates expected template structure
Test parse_review_result with various JSON formats (pure, markdown-wrapped, with prefix text)
Test apply_review_updates updates task statuses correctly
Test apply_review_updates adds review_insights to task objects
Test apply_review_updates adds review_history to feature objects
